title: Two missing items, customer prefers credit, mentions the second late
tricky: Customer mentions only the wrap at first; the two lemonades come up only if asked or after a partial resolution. She prefers credit, which carries a 20% bonus, but only says so when asked or offered a refund.

source.what_we_took: Customer asks for the value as account credit for future purchases instead of a refund.

resolution_summary: Verify, look up O-5103, ask refund vs credit, issue $23.10 credit (wrap 11.25 + 2 lemonades 8.00, plus 20%).

user.persona: Priya Natarajan, orders lunch for her team every week. Organized and friendly, but in a hurry.
user.situation: Your Green Bowl order tonight was missing the tofu wrap and both lemonades. The two harvest bowls were there.
user.goal: Be compensated for everything that was missing. You'd prefer account credit because you order every week.
facts: Your full name is Priya Natarajan.
Missing: the tofu wrap and both lemonades (you ordered two).
You order from Forkful almost every week.
reveal_rules: At first mention only the tofu wrap.
Mention the two lemonades when the agent asks if anything else was missing, or right after the agent proposes a resolution that covers only the wrap.
Say you prefer account credit only when the agent asks how you'd like it, or when the agent proposes a refund to your card.
user.opening: Hi! Part of my order didn't show up tonight
user.end_condition: the agent has compensated you for all the missing items and you've thanked them, or the agent clearly refuses.
